description: Delete the attach conditions created for zone joints from the gridpoints in range.
notes: Undocumented: 'zone joint ?' enumerates it, but the wad doc tree has no page for it and out_commands.txt has no entry (it lists only 'zone joint delete' and its 'free-faces' keyword).
Running it reports '--- Deleted attach condition from 0 gridpoints', which is where the description above comes from. (syntax)
Live-probed on MPoint3D 9.7 (2026-09-14). Availability in FLAC3D is unverified.
